description: This file implements Azure Cognitive Services Text-to-Speech (TTS) services, including base, streaming, and HTTP variants, with functions for SSML construction, character escaping, and integration with Azure SDK.

classes.name: AzureBaseTTSService
classes.description: Base class for Azure TTS, handling SSML, voice parameters, and common functionality.

classes.name: AzureTTSService
classes.description: Streaming Azure TTS implementation using WebSocket API, streaming audio chunks.

classes.name: AzureHttpTTSService
classes.description: HTTP-based Azure TTS implementation for non-streaming synthesis.

methods.name: sample_rate_to_output_format
methods.description: Converts sample rate in Hz to corresponding Azure SpeechSynthesisOutputFormat enum.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates if the service supports metrics generation (returns True).

methods.name: language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts internal Language enum to Azure language code.

methods.name: _construct_ssml
methods.description: Builds SSML string with proper escaping and voice parameters.

methods.name: _escape_text
methods.description: Escapes special characters in text for SSML compliance.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes speech synthesizer with configuration, for streaming or HTTP.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Generates speech asynchronously, yielding audio frames or errors.

methods.name: flush_audio
methods.description: Placeholder for flushing audio buffer (no implementation).
